--- integers
on t()
    return {0, 1, -1, 42, 536870911, -536870912, 1073741823, 2147483647, -2147483648, 4294967296, 1.0E+15}
end t
--- reals
on t()
    return {1.5, -0.25, 3.14159, 1.0E+10, 1.0E-10, 0.1, 100.0, 2.5E+3, 6.02E+23, -1.0E-3}
end t
--- strings
on t()
    return {"", "a", "two words", "tab\there", "line\nfeed", "return\rhere", "quote\"inside", "back\\slash", "é ü ñ", "日本語", "emoji 🎉"}
end t
--- booleans and missing
on t()
    return {true, false, missing value, null}
end t
--- text constants
on t()
    return {space, tab, return, linefeed, quote, pi, missing value}
end t
--- text constants in concatenation
on t(x)
    return x & return & tab & x & space & quote & linefeed
end t
--- nested lists
on t()
    return {{}, {1}, {1, {2, {3, {4}}}}, {{}, {{}}}, {"a", 1, true, 1.5, missing value}}
end t
--- records keyword labels
on t()
    return {name:"n", id:1, class:"c", length:2, size:3, color:{0, 0, 0}, bounds:{1, 2, 3, 4}, index:1, version:"1"}
end t
--- records user labels
on t()
    return {alpha:1, beta:"two", gammaValue:{nested:true, deeper:{deepest:0}}, |with space|:3, |end|:4}
end t
--- record mixed
on t(x)
    return {name:x, alpha:x, visible:true, |my key|:x}
end t
--- empty record like
on t()
    set r to {}
    return r
end t
--- classes as values
on t()
    return {integer, real, text, string, list, record, boolean, date, number, class, alias, file, script, application, item, character, word, paragraph, data, constant, handler, reference, Unicode text, POSIX file, RGB color, centimeters, inches}
end t
--- class comparisons
on t(x)
    return {class of x is integer, class of x = text, class of x is not list, class of x is in {integer, real}}
end t
--- raw data
on t()
    return «data rdat48656C6C6F»
end t
--- raw class and constant
on t()
    return {«class abcd», «constant ****efgh», «class utf8», «class furl»}
end t
--- months and weekdays
on t()
    return {January, February, December, Monday, Sunday, Jan, Mon}
end t
--- time constants
on t()
    return {minutes, hours, days, weeks, 2 * hours + 30 * minutes}
end t
--- current date
on t()
    set d to current date
    return {year of d, month of d, day of d, weekday of d, time of d, hours of d, minutes of d, seconds of d, date string of d, time string of d, short date string of d}
end t
--- posix file literal
on t()
    return {POSIX file "/tmp", POSIX path of (path to home folder), "/tmp" as POSIX file}
end t
--- file and alias specifiers
on t(p)
    return {file p, alias p, file "a:b:c", POSIX file p}
end t
--- result variable
on t(x)
    x + 1
    set a to result
    x & "s"
    return {a, result}
end t
--- me it my
on t(x)
    return {me, it, class of me, name of me, my name, x's length, length of x}
end t
--- bar identifiers
on t()
    set |a b| to 1
    set |name| to 2
    set |item| to 3
    set |end| to 4
    return {|a b|, |name|, |item|, |end|}
end t
--- identifier cases
on t()
    set camelCase to 1
    set with_underscore to 2
    set x2 to 3
    set UPPER to 4
    return camelCase + with_underscore + x2 + UPPER
end t
--- text class forms
on t(x)
    return {x as text, x as string, x as Unicode text, x as «class utf8», x as list, x as integer, x as real, x as number, x as boolean, x as record, x as alias, x as date}
end t
--- coercion of literals
on t()
    return {"12" as integer, 12 as text, {1, 2} as text, "a" as list, 1.9 as integer, true as integer, 3 as real}
end t
--- units
on t(x)
    return {x as inches, x as centimeters, (x as feet) as meters, x as degrees Fahrenheit, x as kilograms, x as gallons, x as square meters}
end t
--- list of handlers
on a()
    return 1
end a

on t()
    set f to a
    return {f, a, class of a}
end t
--- script literal value
on t()
    script inner
        property p : 1
    end script
    return {inner, p of inner, class of inner}
end t
--- application values
on t()
    return {application "Finder", application id "com.apple.finder", current application, name of current application}
end t
--- negative literals
on t(x)
    return {-1, -1.5, - x, x - 1, x - -1, x * -2, -(x + 1), -x ^ 2, 2 ^ -x}
end t
--- large and odd numbers
on t()
    return {1.0E+308, 1.0E-308, 0.0, 1.0, 123456789012, 9.99999999999E+11, 0.5, 12345.678}
end t
--- string with special
on t()
    return {"«»", "|", "--", "(* *)", "¬", "{}", "a'b", "\"\"", "\\\\", "end tell"}
end t
--- data in list with text
on t(x)
    return {x, {x}, {x, x}, {{x}}, {a:x}, {a:{x}}, {{a:x}}}
end t
--- class of a constant
on t()
    set a to class of "x"
    set b to class of class of "x"
    if class of 5 is integer then set a to class of 1.5
    return {a, b, class of true, class of missing value, class of text, class of "x" as text}
end t
--- reference to the class of a constant in a property
property p : a reference to class of "x"

on t()
    return {p, a reference to class of 5}
end t
--- references kept in properties
property q : 5
property p : {1, 2}
property r : a reference to q
property s : a reference to item 1 of p
property t : a reference to length of p
property u : a reference to every item of {1, 2}
property v : a reference to items 1 thru 2 of {1, 2, 3}
property w : a reference to some item of {1, 2}
property x : a reference to middle item of {1, 2, 3}

script inner
    property a : 1
    property b : a reference to a
    property c : a reference to q
end script

property y : a reference to a of inner
